verdict.rationale: Viam's evidence shows strong hardware abstraction (same API across camera/motor brands, swap hardware without rewriting code) and driver registry, which is architecturally adjacent to sim-to-real, but there is no mention anywhere of a simulation environment, simulated components, digital twin, or explicit sim-to-real workflow. The axis is fair for a robotics platform, but no evidence demonstrates Viam actually supports running the same code against a simulated robot.
